headline: I Am The Diplomatic Aide Currently Tasked With Explaining 'Global Geopolitics' To A Cat
body:
My official title is 'Senior Liaison for Extraordinary Mediations,' but since Tuesday, my actual job description has been to sit in a soundproofed embassy basement and explain the intricacies of territorial sovereignty to a lukewarm tabby named Sir Pounce. The brief was simple: find a neutral party to facilitate the upcoming weekend peace talks. Apparently, after three months of failed Zoom calls, the only entity deemed sufficiently disinterested in global hegemony was this specific feline, who was currently asleep on a copy of the Geneva Convention.

Yesterday, I spent four hours trying to convince Sir Pounce that the concept of 'spheres of influence' is better suited for a scratching post than a geopolitical map. He mostly responded by batting at my laser pointer whenever I pointed to disputed border regions. I’m quite certain that if the envoys arrive on Saturday and expect a breakthrough, they are going to be disappointed by the fact that the mediator’s only policy proposal involves a dramatic increase in the national tuna import quota.

I’ve tried taking notes on his 'responses'—mostly purrs and slow blinks—but I’m running out of ink. If I report back that the path to peace is paved with wet food and a lukewarm belly rub, I suspect my diplomatic career might be over. Still, I’ve seen worse strategies in the history books, and at the very least, this mediator has never once interrupted me during a presentation to check his phone.
caption: The state of international diplomacy has hit a new peak, or perhaps a new low. When cats become the only neutral ground left, maybe it's time to stock up on tuna. #Geopolitics #Diplomacy #CatLogic #PeaceTalks (satire)
